purpose: 선택 욕구가 타인의 승인이나 대리 결정이 아니라 정해진 두 수호령의 독립 제어점·이유 설명·열린 경청 공간으로 읽히는 shared-world 12개 편집 검토안이다.

renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-desire shared-world guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the two named guardians or canonical internal pair and no third guardian, adviser, family member, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection or implied person. Preserve identities, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and visible chest Stella stars. The pair plus one shared choice setting covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Give each guardian one independent desire, question, return or reality control and keep a broad open listening gap; never imply hierarchy, proxy decision, compulsory care, correct choice, destiny or guaranteed outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Doors, pads, seals, tokens, lamps, trays and bays remain ajar, removable, unnamed or open-ended. Libra may use exactly one abstract choice balance; no other sign uses a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
